data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱1,650,000 – ₱2,300,000 (varies by trim, engine, and options — local pricing may shift)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,640 × 1,865 × 1,665 Wheelbase (mm): 2,755 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options (typical):
2.5 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline (standard)
Maximum Output: ~187 hp Maximum Torque: ~178 lb-ft (~242 Nm) — depends on variant
In markets where available: Hybrid or turbo-gasoline + hybrid variants (depending on trim/region) — output varies accordingly.
Transmission: 8-speed Automatic (standard on gasoline) / Automatic variants for hybrid/turbo-hybrid (where offered) Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) or All-Wheel Drive (AWD), depending on variant
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: ~900 kg – 1,000 kg (light towing only; typical compact-SUV class rating)
Payload Capacity: Approx. 500–550 kg (passengers + cargo; varies by load and trim)
Fuel Tank Capacity: ~54 L (gasoline/diesel variants; hybrid may vary slightly)
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Cargo / Boot Space: Generous by compact-SUV standards. With rear seats upright — decent luggage space; folding rear seats expands cargo capacity significantly for larger loads.
Infotainment & Features: Modern touchscreen infotainment (size depends on trim), connectivity (smartphone integration), comfortable cabin with amenities (varies by variant/trims).
Speakers & Comfort Options: Varies by trim — base to mid trims more basic, higher trims with premium audio/comfort extras.
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Disc brakes (ventilated front, solid rear typical)
Suspension: Independent front suspension, rear suspension tuned for balanced ride + handling (suitable for both urban and rougher roads)
Tires / Wheels: Common setup: 235/60 R18 alloy wheels (or similar) on many trims; lower trims may have smaller wheel/tire combos — depends on variant
